Second end-to-end QA pass of the Results Explorer (run on Chromium 147,
with a Firefox 148 spot-check on the cold-load finding) against the
dev server at http://localhost:5173/results/, scored against the
pass-2 test plan at
`_project/audits/results-explorer-qa-pass2-test-plan.md`.

Tester totals: P=30, F=16, Q=10. Full report:
`_project/audits/results-explorer-qa-pass2-findings.md`.

This item supersedes the still-open work in
`results-explorer-qa-pass1-fixes`. Status update against the pass-1
bugs (verified during pass-2):

  B1 (PlatformIndex headers don't sort)             still open + scope expanded
  B2 (empty duckdb/polars platform pages)           CLOSED — pages now render rows
  B3 (`/does-not-exist/` ≠ NotFound)                partly fixed — multi-segment paths now hit NotFound; single-segment slugs still fall through to BenchmarkIndex
  B4 (TimeSeries duplicate-key warning)             still open — same warning text
  Q1 (`?metric=` toggle)                            resolved as an answer: there is no in-page toggle and the URL param is dead code (read into state, then overwritten by `getPrimaryMetricForBenchmark()` on load)

Pass-2 also surfaced six genuinely new product issues:

  N1  S1.6 / S10.1   Cold-load Home renders the empty corpus (`0 / 0 / 0` cards + "No leaderboard cells match") before DuckDB-WASM has attached. Warm reloads are fine. Highest user-facing impact in this pass.
  N2  S3.3 / S3.8    BenchmarkIndex silently coerces `?phase=` to an available phase while leaving the URL untouched — URL and rendered cohort can disagree without any visible cue.
  N3  S9             BenchmarkIndex preserves invalid `?sf=abc` and renders a blank page instead of falling back to a known scale factor.
  N4  S6.5           Compare with `?ids=<single>` renders a single-platform "comparison" instead of redirecting to ResultDetail or showing a "need 2+" message.
  N5  S1.4           `document.title` never changes per route — every page is "BenchBox Results Explorer".
  N6  S7.5           Query workbench has no UI to switch between `DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT` and `UNLIMITED_ROW_LIMIT`; the constants exist, the toggle does not.

Plus one plan errata (not a code change):

  E1  S2.2  The pass-2 plan asserted Speedup ratios should be ≥1; the explorer's design is "best=1.00×, slower entries <1". Plan needs a one-line fix.

Confirmed-but-not-actionable findings (corpus too thin to exercise the
control: S3.4 trust+tuning chips, S5.5 tuning sidecar, S6.2 four-platform
same-cohort compare) are not work units here — they're tracked as a
separate `seed-richer-qa-fixture-corpus` candidate (not yet filed).

Sequencing rationale: w1 and w2 are research/decision units that gate
w12 and w6 respectively; w3..w11 are mechanical and parallel-safe;
w13..w14 finalise docs and e2e; w15 is the final acceptance gate.

work_units.notes:
DECISION: N1 is a loading-state/data-readiness race where
`listResults()` can briefly resolve to an empty array on a cold
DuckDB-WASM attach, and Home treats that empty array as loaded
final state while the meta-leaderboard data is allowed to arrive
independently.

Evidence:
  - QA pass-2 captured the exact mixed state: `0 Results / 0
    Benchmarks / 0 Platforms` plus "No leaderboard cells match";
    a later module probe against the same snapshot returned 12
    rows, and warm reloads rendered correctly
    (`_project/audits/results-explorer-qa-pass2-findings.md:46-65`).
  - `Home.tsx:34-43` launches `listResults()` and
    `getMetaLeaderboardData()` independently. `Home.tsx:135`
    gates only on `!results`, so `[]` is considered loaded.
  - Once `results === []`, `resultById` is empty
    (`Home.tsx:53-55`). If `metaLeaderboard` then resolves,
    `filteredMetaLeaderboard` drops every cohort because each
    cohort requires at least one platform row whose `result_id`
    exists in `resultById` (`Home.tsx:74-83`), producing an
    empty `cohorts` array (`Home.tsx:117-121`).
  - The visible zero cards are rendered directly from the
    empty `results` array (`Home.tsx:200-203`), and the empty
    leaderboard copy renders when `filteredMetaLeaderboard` is
    truthy with `cohorts.length === 0` (`Home.tsx:283-286`).
  - `db.ts:106-110` already has the pass-1 PlatformIndex
    projection-readiness fence, so the next fix should not
    broaden `db.ts` first. The Home-specific bug is that its UI
    can combine an empty result snapshot with non-empty cohort
    metadata and make that transient look authoritative.

Winning hypothesis: H2 is the likely cold-load trigger
(`listResults()` can resolve `[]` before the snapshot is fully
useful), and H3 is the UI paint condition that turns the trigger
into a visible bug. H1 alone is too narrow because the recorded
state includes zero result stat cards, not just a leaderboard
placeholder.

Code surfaces for w6:
  1. `results-explorer/src/pages/Home.tsx` -- introduce an
     explicit Home data loading state that waits for both
     `listResults()` and `getMetaLeaderboardData()` to settle
     before rendering stat cards and MetaLeaderboard. Preserve
     the legitimate no-leaderboard case by distinguishing
     "leaderboard still loading" from "leaderboard loaded as
     null because the corpus has no eligible 2+ platform
     cohorts."
  2. `results-explorer/src/pages/__tests__/Home.test.tsx` --
     add a regression test with staged promises: resolve
     `listResults()` to `[]` first, keep meta-leaderboard
     pending/then resolve it, and assert the page keeps showing
     the loading spinner rather than 0/0/0 or "No leaderboard
     cells match."
  3. `results-explorer/e2e/routes/home.spec.ts` -- add or
     strengthen a cold-load assertion that the empty-corpus copy
     never appears before `Recent Results`/leaderboard data is
     visible.

Reproduce on a hard refresh of `/results/` (DevTools "Disable cache"
checked, "Preserve log" on). Capture the timing of:
  - Initial render (which strings appear first — "Loading..." or "0 Results"?)
  - DuckDB-WASM .duckdb fetch start/end
  - getMetaLeaderboardData() resolve
  - listResults() resolve

Hypothesis ladder, narrowest first:
  H1  Race in `Home.tsx`: the loading guard is `if (!results)`,
      but `setResults([])` may run before the meta-leaderboard
      `getMetaLeaderboardData()` resolves, briefly painting an
      empty corpus before the leaderboard fills in.
  H2  `listResults()` returns `[]` (not throw) when the DuckDB
      view isn't attached yet; the `null`-vs-`[]` distinction is
      being lost before the spinner can render.
  H3  StatCard counts (`results.length`, `benchmarks.length`,
      `platformIds.length`) are computed unconditionally from
      `results ?? []`, so an in-flight empty array paints the
      zero state for one frame.

Output of this unit: a one-paragraph diagnosis on this work
unit's notes naming the winning hypothesis with file:line evidence,
and a short list of code surfaces that need to change in w6.

`primaryMetric` state/setter from ResultDetail and Compare, then
store the resolved metric together with the loaded detail/results

Currently `BenchmarkIndex.tsx:42-44` reads `sf` as a string with
no validator, then keys data fetches off `effectiveSf =
scaleFilter ?? scaleFactors[0] ?? "0.01"`. If the URL is
`?sf=abc`, the scale filter is `"abc"` and the cohort lookup
finds nothing, blanking the page.

Fix: on URL hydration, validate the sf value against
`scaleFactors` (loaded from the manifest). If invalid, fall
through to the default (`scaleFactors[0]`) AND coerce the URL
back to that default with a single replaceState (matching w7's
pattern — extract a small helper if w7 ships first).
